says: Rows 251 and 258 of the experiments index have six cells, a trailing '$0', against the table's five-column header.
proof: git show origin/main:experiments/README.md | awk -F'|' '/^\| 2[0-9][0-9] /{print $2, NF-2}' prints 6 for 251 and 258 (lines 296 and 303) and 5 for every other row from 238 to 261; the header at line 52 has 5.
cost: GitHub renders an extra cell past the Result column on those two rows, and a writer copying a neighbor copies the wrong shape (PR 797's row 250 had the same sixth cell).
